dialogs.text: Eek! Th—There's someone on the ground!
(Examine the fallen person...)
Is... Is he...?
He's still alive, just unconscious.
Phew! That's good.
We have to get help! We can't just leave him like this!

You and Paimon deliver the unconscious man to Lumidouce Harbor.\nThe people there immediately take him to receive medical treatment.\nKnowing that he is in good hands, the two of you return to where you were before.
Alright! Now let's have a look at this stone tablet.
"Lo, this place is the Orthant of Wishes, the Temple of Wishes, the Room of Wishes..."
"Often contradicting"... "Born in an instant, your company in eternal rest, never separated"... "The tainted fruits of sin"...
Looks like a riddle!
#Hmm... What do you think the answer is then, {NICKNAME}?
A dream?
Paimon doesn't think so... Just what kind of weird thing would you have to dream up for it to be a sin?
#Hmm... What do you think the answer is then, {NICKNAME}?
Guilt?
Paimon doesn't think that's it. Paimon only feels guilty about something for 15 minutes, tops.
#Hmm... What do you think the answer is then, {NICKNAME}?
Life?
Sounds strange. Can life really bear original sin?
Still, Paimon thinks she might have heard that somewhere before. Let's go with that answer for now.
...Shouldn't you be more concerned with the person lying on the ground in your field of vision?
Huh? Wah! What happened...?
My apologies, Miss. I prioritized the search for the stone tablet. Allow me to conduct a scan now...
...My apologies, Miss.
What!?
Though he's still alive, the breath of life has escaped his body through the orifices. I've seen this handiwork before...
Eek! Paimon can't look.
We have to get help! We can't just leave him like this!

Together, you deliver the unconscious man to Lumidouce Harbor.\nThe people there immediately take him to receive medical treatment.\nKnowing that he is in good hands, you all return to where you were before.
Alright! Now let's have a look at this stone tablet.
"Lo, this place is the Orthant of Wishes, the Temple of Wishes, the Room of Wishes..."
"Often contradicting"... "Born in an instant, your company in eternal rest, never separated"... "The tainted fruits of sin"...
Another riddle.
Why do something so scary here... Could it have something to do with the answer to the riddle?
Well, Fontainians are "sinners," life tainted with original sin.
For this reason, the answer is "life." I suppose I'd guessed it already.
Can you be sure that's the answer?
I know the rhetoric and semiotics of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo all too well. Barring any surprises, that is the answer.
Okay, it's time to make up for lost time. We need to hurry now.
You carefully inspect the top of the mechanism, but you don't find anything.
There's nothing here?
Oh no! It looks like someone already took whatever was here.
But who?
You carefully inspect the top of the mechanism, but you don't find anything.
There's nothing here either...
You carefully inspect the top of the mechanism, but you don't find anything.
Did someone... take whatever was here, too?
You carefully inspect the top of the mechanism, but you don't find anything.
There's nothing here?
It looks like something was here, but someone else took it.
Wait, doesn't that mean that our plan's already failed?
The birth of "Reason" requires the merging of the four Orthants. If we can get the rest of them, we still have a chance.
In that case, we'd better hurry to the next area.
You carefully inspect the top of the mechanism, but you don't find anything.
There's nothing here either...
What exactly are we looking for, Caterpillar?
We're looking for the materials necessary to forge the Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz.
The Ordo was able to reproduce the four requisite hypothetical substances here in the material world, based on the esoteric philosophies of the underground kingdom and ancient Fontaine.
I do not understand.
These enigmatic substances are purely experiential. You could say they are even further beyond ordinary logic than elemental power.
I entered all introductory to intermediate level textbooks from the Akademiya's Spantamad into my memory banks decades ago. There is nothing mysterious about elemental power.
Is that so? Anyway, to sum up, this is born of the confluence of traditions from Fontaine and technology from the ancient underground kingdom.
And thus, four types of substance came into being: Memory, Wish, Soul, and Persona.
To avoid any possible ambiguity, let's call them the "Memory" piece, "Wish" piece, "Soul" piece, and "Persona" piece.
Why are these used to make the Holy Blade?
In the Narzissenkreuz Ordo's brand of mystical philosophy, the temple is a microcosm of the universe, the members are stand-ins for the gods, and the holy oil is tempered willpower.
The Holy Blade, on the other hand, is "reason," that which cuts everything open. It can only be born out of consummate human will.
Quite abstruse.
That's esotericism for you. You attach yourself to anything that looks similar enough, and when this sort of thing becomes magic, fiction becomes reality.
Anyway, we should make our way to the next area now.
You carefully inspect the top of the mechanism, but you don't find anything.
Did someone... take whatever was here, too?
Looks that way.
Just who is...?
It's Jakob.
We had an altercation with him inside Elynas once... Clarification: Recently, not "once."
When I saw that unfortunate victim at the gate, I knew it was his handiwork. It seems he's still active after all.
Then what does he want with the stuff he took from here?
Simple — He too wants to reforge the Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz. The dream of the Ordo remains unrealized.
Anyway, we should make our way to the final area now.
